items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I tried to get Charlotte into music

ctx.x: Danny got him a fiddle, and a...I don't know about the guitar.

Same with my kids. I tried to get Charlotte into music, and she was trying to practice that piano, and I was hollering, 'That's an F-sharp, not F-natural,' and the tears was coming. And she's wondering how I knew it was F-sharp, and I'm way upstairs, you know. And one day, Mona said to me, 'Hey, everybody can't be a musician.' I mean, it turned off my daughter.
Well, Sylvia's got the (?). She acts.
